description: For a learner forming an interpretation of another person or group, structured perspective-taking with concrete accounts and comparison of interpretations may improve attitudes towards that group, a relationship qualified by outcome, dose, target and horizon.
title: Building Empathy

description: For school-age learners, a schoolwide plan kept for two or more years (one definition shared by all adults, supervised and organised unstructured times, rehearsed bystander and defender moves, several reporting routes including anonymous ones, and an incident response that protects the target, with separate steps for cyberbullying) is expected to reduce bullying and fear of it more than a response aimed only at the bully and target after incidents; trials of schoolwide behaviour, recess and restorative programmes test schoolwide action against comparison schools, but no claim tests the role-focused design or a cyberbullying response.
title: Bullying Prevention and Intervention
